english.title: Knowingly allow person under 18 to sell alcohol - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a responsible person on relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), knowingly allowed an individual, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), to make on those premises a sale of alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..) which had not been specifically approved by you or another responsible person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 153(1)(a) and (3) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a responsible person for relevant premises
knowingly allowed person under the age of 18
to make on those premises a sale of alcohol
which had not been specifically approved by you or another responsible person

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 153(2) specifies where this offence does not apply.
(ii) Section 152(4) provides an interpretation of the term "responsible person".

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
